axis_warning: Shading presets are NOT lighting levels L0-L5, NOT lighting packs V5/V6, NOT gold presets. Separate axis.
normals_warning: Normals are ESTIMATED from distance transform, NOT a true 3D mesh pass. True 3D model normal pass still owed 0/1.
base: rig-apose-v7c-clean-transparent.png 1100x1500, mask 373846px, centre x561.5; arms-up mask 369712px, centre x550. Base art untouched; presets are copies/overlays/parameters, never a recolour of the base.

ARCHIVE.definition: Set One, Mars label BARELY WORKS. Record of what did not work. Use: historical reference only.
ARCHIVE.use: Never for production shading. Exceptions I05/I06/X08 are visibly moved, NOT true form shading.

REFERENCE.definition: Controls and flaw records. V0 = no shade, V1 = old G2 flaw reproduced.
REFERENCE.use: Use to prove a new shading run actually moves form (compare edge delta to V0 +1.8 / V1 +0.5).

CLEAN.definition: Cleanest production form. Smooth or clean on its plate, high form signal without apose faceting.
CLEAN.use: Use first on apose: V9, V7, V10. Use on arms-up: HERO, X01-ARMS, X07-ARMS.
CLEAN.do_not_use_for: Do not apply an arms-up preset to apose without re-checking faceting

STRONG.definition: Strong form signal, high edge delta, but FACETED on the apose plate (dense linework + narrow limbs).
STRONG.use: Use on arms-up, or as a strength reference. Do not ship as a clean apose relight.

SOFT.definition: Mild, ambient, rim, or top light. Low half-mean movement, gentle form.
SOFT.use: Use for subtle shading, ambient fill, rim-only, or top-light shots where left/right must NOT move much.

EXPERIMENTAL.definition: New methods and proxies. All PIL runs on the same normal field, with proxy limits labelled per preset.
EXPERIMENTAL.use: Use to test a look; check the per-preset proxy note before shipping.
EXPERIMENTAL.do_not_use_for: Do not quote a proxy as the true method (SSS, Shader-to-RGB node, limb segmentation, guided/bilateral)

TEST_ONLY.definition: Test only. X10 inverse, light from the wrong side by design.
TEST_ONLY.use: Use only as a negative control.
